title: Война с соседом и поиск жилья  (War with the Neighbor and the Apartment Hunt)

scenes.title: A Bad Day from the Start
scenes.summary: Max starts the day optimistically, gets scolded by Nagiyev outside the restaurant, and learns from Kostya that he must move out of their apartment.

scenes.title: Grandpa Kirill's Flare-Up
scenes.summary: Max arrives late covered in soup and learns about Grandpa Kirill, the stubborn retired officer living above the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Keys to Vika's Apartment
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov orders seafood for Grandpa Kirill, and Vika hands the keys to her prepaid apartment to Nastya and Kostya.

scenes.title: A Gift with a Catch
scenes.summary: Nastya and Kostya give Vika's apartment keys to Max, who indignantly refuses to live in his ex-girlfriend's flat.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Goes to Negotiate
scenes.summary: After Grandpa Kirill disrupts the restaurant, Chef Barinov and Nagiyev argue over how to handle him, and Nagiyev goes upstairs himself.

scenes.title: Ensign Zadov and Money
scenes.summary: Grandpa Kirill recognizes Nagiyev as TV character Ensign Zadov, accuses him of disgracing the army, and fumes when offered money.

scenes.title: Salt, Cognac, and Clean Clothes
scenes.summary: A doctor treats Nagiyev's rock-salt wound, Chef Barinov prepares to visit Kirill with cognac, and Nastya packs Max's clothes.

scenes.title: Nursery Repairs and a Paid Viewing
scenes.summary: Kostya questions Nastya about hiring a worker without asking him, and Max pays an elderly landlady a fee just to view her apartment.

scenes.title: Apartment for Girls Only
scenes.summary: The landlady refuses to rent to Max after taking his viewing fee, while Chef Barinov makes peace with Grandpa Kirill over cognac.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Condition and Katya's Help
scenes.summary: Nagiyev refuses to kneel to Grandpa Kirill and calls in thugs, while Katya rents the apartment in her name so Max can move in.

scenes.title: Hiding in the Closet
scenes.summary: Max hides in the wardrobe when the landlady returns for a blanket, and Katya pretends the wardrobe door is stuck.

scenes.title: The Fresh Paint Trap
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya return home to find that their handyman painted the floor instead of the walls and trapped himself in the corner.

scenes.title: Pills for the Thugs
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya argue over the botched nursery work, while Grandpa Kirill tricks Nagiyev's thugs and chases them out of his apartment.

scenes.title: Courtyard Explosion and Max's Plea
scenes.summary: Grandpa Kirill blows up Nagiyev's car and gets the thugs arrested, while Max asks Katya to stay at the apartment a bit longer.

scenes.title: The Next-Door Neighbor
scenes.summary: Max discovers the landlady lives right next door, and since he spent all his money on rent and deposit, Katya helps him set up a warning system.

scenes.title: Water Meters and a Brick Wall
scenes.summary: Katya stops the landlady from entering the bathroom while Max is inside, and Grandpa Kirill bricks up the doorway at the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Apartment Scam Exposed
scenes.summary: Nagiyev storms off to confront Grandpa Kirill, and the landlady exposes Max and Katya's ruse and evicts Max without returning his money.

scenes.title: A Truce on Bended Knee
scenes.summary: Thinking Nagiyev killed Grandpa Kirill, Chef Barinov confronts him, and when Kirill walks out alive, Nagiyev apologizes on his knees.

scenes.title: Eviction and Moving to Vika's
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya's landlady evicts them for having a baby on the way, while Max moves into Vika's apartment and runs into Vika.

scenes.title: Happy Housewarming, Friends!
scenes.summary: Max and Vika give in to their lingering feelings for each other, only for Kostya and Nastya to arrive at the door to move in with them.
